# Kit

Kit is Rowan’s old school friend. The friendship was already established before Rowan moved to a room above a bakery in Bellwick; the move was not their first meeting.[^1]

Kit helped carry the books up two flights. In Rowan’s later recollection of the first evening, Kit had left but sent an empty-bookshelf photo with a joke about their arms enjoying retirement. On 21 September 2019, Rowan wrote that Kit had come back with a folding table borrowed from their aunt. Rowan returned it to Kit on 19 December 2019, and Kit took it back to their aunt, as Rowan later clarified.[^2]

These records show Kit’s part in [the room’s first months](../../30_Stories/Chapters/The%20yellow%20mug%20on%20the%20windowsill.md). They do not yet tell the story of how the school friendship began.

[^1]: Rowan’s [interview, answer 1](../../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-first-move.md#answer-1).
[^2]: [At the bakery window, 2019-09-09](../../80_Sources/imports/c8b6e8bbe42ebbc4a58c8f213d0ffa6f89e5ae5bb9a9efbcb0ba20c0ddfc3508-r1.md#^record-c8b6e8bbe42ebbc4a58c8f213d0ffa6f89e5ae5bb9a9efbcb0ba20c0ddfc3508-r1); Rowan’s [interview, answer 2](../../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-first-move.md#answer-2); [A table at last, 2019-09-21](../../80_Sources/imports/7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1.md#^record-7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1); [The window in winter, 2020-01-12](../../80_Sources/imports/98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1.md#^record-98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1).
